a1
Abraham was old. He told his oldest servant: find a wife for my son Isaac among my own family.
b1
The servant took ten camels to a well at evening.
b2
He prayed: Lord, let the young woman who offers me a drink, and water for my camels too, be the one you chose for Isaac.
c1
Before he finished, Rebekah came with her jar. She gave him a drink, and drew water for all ten camels.
c2
He bowed: blessed be the Lord, who led me to my master's family.
d1
Her family said: this comes from the Lord. They asked Rebekah: will you go with this man? She said: I will.
e1
Isaac was walking in the field at evening and saw the camels coming.
e2
Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent. He loved her, and was comforted after his mother's death.
h1
The servant asked God for a sign, and watched for kindness.
h2
Rebekah offered water to a stranger, and to all his camels.
h3
God often leads us through ordinary kindness, and hears us before we finish asking.
h4
Today, pray for guidance, and be kind where you are.
i
Whose prayer could your kindness answer today?
